analyst/en/L5: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xmlns:mstts="https://www.w3.org/2001/mstts" xml:lang="en-US"><voice name="en-US-GuyNeural"><mstts:express-as style="excited" styledegree="1.5"><prosody rate="+10%" pitch="+4%">H8 found H9 with a 42-metre pass.</prosody></mstts:express-as></voice></speak>
